look.why: A warm golden savanna amber echoing sunlit grasslands and complementing the tawny spotted coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 2.1 m (body length 1.1–1.5 m plus 0.6–0.8 m tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Open savannas, dry grasslands and semi-deserts across sub-Saharan Africa, with a tiny remnant population in Iran.

diet.text: Thomson's gazelles, impalas, springboks, hares and ground birds chased down in high-speed daytime sprints.

facts.text: The fastest land mammal on Earth, accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in about three seconds.
Black tear marks running down its face deflect harsh savanna glare and help keep prey in focus.

id.diet: Gazel Thomson, impala, springbok, terwelu, dan burung darat yang dikejar dalam lari cepat siang hari.
facts: Mamalia darat tercepat di Bumi, mampu berakselerasi dari 0 hingga 100 km/jam dalam sekitar tiga detik.
Garis hitam seperti air mata di wajahnya meredam silau matahari sabana agar pandangan tetap fokus pada mangsa.
